goal: Replace .github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml's tag-string regex guess for GitHub Release pre-release status with a real ReleaseEntry.is_prerelease boolean computed from Version::is_prerelease() at plan time.
architecture: Add a required `is_prerelease: bool` field to `ReleaseEntry` in crates/callisto-model/src/plan.rs, populate it at plan_publish's one construction site (crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs) via the already-parsed `ver.is_prerelease()`, and fix every other struct literal the new required field forces (crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/publish.rs and crates/callisto-graph/tests/{tag_sha_fabrication_test.rs,tags_tests.rs}) in the same task so no commit leaves the workspace non-compiling. Add fixture-value regression tests proving the field is correct for SemVer and PEP 440 pre-release and non-pre-release versions. Update crates/callisto-cli/tests/schema_guard_test.rs's expected schema sets and allowlist. Add a grep/cargo-metadata based verification task for the two structural acceptance criteria (no fallback branch at the construction site; no new AGPL dependency edge) and confirm the full Rust suite is green. Switch action.yml's GitHub Release loop from a tag-string regex to iterating `.releases[]` entries and reading `isPrerelease` directly off each entry, hard-failing on a missing/null/non-boolean value, with a new extraction-and-stub bash test proving that behavior against action.yml's live text. Finally document the new field in docs/01-spec.md's ReleaseEntry doc block and decision table.
reasoning: Ordering constraint: adding a required field to ReleaseEntry (AC-001) makes the whole cargo workspace fail to compile until every construction site is fixed, because callisto-graph and callisto-cli both construct ReleaseEntry (production site + 7 sibling struct literals across 3 files). Rust's whole-crate/workspace compilation model means any commit that lands the field addition alone, without ALSO fixing the production site (AC-007) and all 7 sibling literals (AC-012b), leaves a non-compiling commit in git history. I therefore combined AC-001 + AC-007 + AC-012b into a single task (T1) rather than three separate commits -- the edits are individually trivial (one new field, one computed assignment, seven `is_prerelease: false,` insertions in test fixtures) so the combined task is still well under 15 minutes and is the only way to keep every commit green. The schema_guard_test.rs update (AC-012a) does NOT block compilation -- schema_guard_test.rs never constructs a ReleaseEntry struct literal, it only introspects `callisto schema --type plan-publish`'s JSON output at runtime -- so it is safe to fix in its own task (T3) immediately after T1, as a normal red (assertion failure, not compile failure) -> green step. Fixture-value tests for AC-002..AC-006 (T2) are split from T1 because they test *correctness of the computed value* across SemVer/PEP 440 grammars, a different concern from *does it compile and is the field wired up at all*; keeping them separate keeps each task's failing-test-to-passing-test story focused on one thing. AC-013 and AC-014 are structural/grep assertions about the diff shape itself (no new conditional branch; no new Cargo dependency), not new runtime behavior, so they get their own grep/cargo-metadata verification task (T4) run after T1-T3 are all green, alongside AC-012c's full-suite-green check. The GitHub Action script change (AC-008/AC-009/AC-015) and its test (AC-010) are combined into one task (T5): writing the new extraction-and-stub test FIRST against the *current* (unedited) action.yml is genuine red, not a placeholder -- the old regex-based loop still calls `gh release create` for a missing/null/non-boolean isPrerelease key (AC-015 requires it must NOT), and misses the AC-005 PEP 440 regression fixture (tag `v1.2.3a1` contains no alpha/beta/rc/pre/next substring, so the old regex never sets --prerelease even though isPrerelease is true) -- so the test fails for exactly the right reasons before action.yml is touched, then passes after the loop is rewritten. Docs (T6) land last since they describe already-implemented, already-tested behavior.

tasks.title: Structural verification: no fallback branch at the construction site, no new AGPL dependency edge, full Rust suite green
steps: This task adds no new code and no new test file -- its "test" is a set of structural/grep/metadata checks run directly against the repository, per the spec's own framing of AC-013 and AC-014 as structural assertions rather than new behavior.

CHECK (AC-013 -- no fallback/branch around the new call): run `grep -n "is_prerelease" crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs`. Expected output: exactly two matching lines -- one showing the pre-existing, unrelated npm dist-tag branch `let tag = if ver.is_prerelease() {` (unchanged, predates this spec), and one showing the new field assignment `is_prerelease: ver.is_prerelease(),` inside the `releases.push(ReleaseEntry { ... })` block. Then run `sed -n '495,515p' crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/publish.rs` and visually confirm the `is_prerelease: ver.is_prerelease(),` line is a bare field assignment inside the struct literal -- not wrapped in any `if`, `match`, `.unwrap_or(...)`, `?`, or `Result`/`Option` construct. If either check fails (a third match appears, or the assignment is conditional), this criterion fails and the construction site in T1 must be corrected back to the plain form before proceeding.

CHECK (AC-014, part 1 -- no new dependency declared): run `git diff --stat crates/callisto-model/Cargo.toml`. Expected output: empty (no output at all) -- this file must be untouched by this spec's changes, proving no new `[dependencies]` entry was added to callisto-model.

CHECK (AC-014, part 2 -- Version::is_prerelease() itself unmodified): run `git diff -- crates/callisto-model/src/version.rs`. Expected output: empty (no output at all) -- version.rs is reused as-is per this spec's non_goals; this task's earlier tasks never touch it.

CHECK (AC-014, part 3 -- resolve graph has no AGPL edge): run `cargo metadata --format-version 1 | jq -r --arg pkg callisto-model '.packages[] | select(.name == $pkg) | .dependencies[].name' | sort -u`. Expected output: exactly callisto-model's direct [dependencies] list per its Cargo.toml -- `camino`, `miette`, `path-slash`, `pep440_rs`, `proptest`, `schemars`, `semver`, `serde`, `serde_json`, `tempfile`, `thiserror` (the last of these, `proptest`, is a pre-existing `[dev-dependencies]` entry, not a `[dependencies]` one -- `cargo metadata`'s `.packages[].dependencies` array does not distinguish dependency kind) -- with no other names; confirm by inspection that none of these is AGPL-licensed. (The older `.resolve.nodes[] | select(.id | startswith($pkg + " "))` form does not work on modern cargo, whose resolve-node id format is `path+file://.../crates/callisto-model#0.3.3`, not `callisto-model 0.3.3 (...)` -- use the `.packages[]` form above instead.)

CHECK (AC-012c -- full suite green): run `cargo nextest run --workspace` (equivalently `just test` / `moon run :test`). Expected output: the run completes with exit code 0 and a summary line of the form `Summary [ ... ] <N> tests run: <N> passed, 0 skipped` with zero failures -- including every test touched by T1, T2, and T3, and no remaining test anywhere in the workspace asserting a ReleaseEntry JSON shape or struct literal that omits `is_prerelease`/`isPrerelease`.

No commit is required for this task if all checks pass as expected -- it verifies work already committed in T1-T3. If any check fails, fix the offending file in the task that introduced it (T1, T2, or T3) and re-run that task's own GREEN command before re-running this task's checks.

tasks.title: Rewrite action.yml's GitHub Release loop to read isPrerelease off each entry, with a regression test proving it
steps:
RED (write the test FIRST, against the current, unedited action.yml): create .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_github_release_prerelease_flag.sh with exactly this content:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regression test for AC-008/AC-009/AC-015: the GitHub Release creation
# loop's --prerelease flag must be derived from each release entry's
# isPrerelease boolean, never from a regex against the tag string, and
# must hard-fail on a missing/null/non-boolean isPrerelease rather than
# silently defaulting to false. Extracts the exact current run-body text
# between the step's ::group::5. Creating GitHub Release Entries marker
# and its matching ::endgroup:: marker directly out of action.yml, so
# this test always exercises the file's current real logic -- it cannot
# drift from it.
set -u
ACTION_YML="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)/action.yml"

extract_snippet() {
  sed -n '/::group::5\. Creating GitHub Release Entries/,/::endgroup::/p' "$ACTION_YML" | sed '1d;$d'
}

run_case() {
  local plan_json="$1"
  local gh_log tmp_script code out
  gh_log="$(mktemp)"
  tmp_script="$(mktemp)"
  {
    echo "gh() { echo \"gh \$*\" >> '${gh_log}'; return 0; }"
    echo "PLAN_JSON='${plan_json}'"
    extract_snippet
  } > "$tmp_script"
  bash "$tmp_script"
  code=$?
  out=$(cat "$gh_log")
  rm -f "$tmp_script" "$gh_log"
  printf '%s\n__EXIT=%d__\n' "$out" "$code"
}

fail=0

# AC-005 regression fixture: PEP 440 pre-release with no alpha/beta/rc/pre/next
# substring in the tag -- isPrerelease:true must still pass --prerelease.
out=$(run_case '{"releases":[{"tagName":"v1.2.3a1","isPrerelease":true}]}')
if [[ "$out" != *"gh release create v1.2.3a1 --title v1.2.3a1 --generate-notes --prerelease"* ]] || [[ "$out" != *"__EXIT=0__"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL isPrerelease:true case: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS isPrerelease:true case"
fi

# isPrerelease:false must run with no --prerelease flag.
out=$(run_case '{"releases":[{"tagName":"v1.0.0","isPrerelease":false}]}')
if [[ "$out" != *"gh release create v1.0.0 --title v1.0.0 --generate-notes"* ]] || [[ "$out" == *"--prerelease"* ]] || [[ "$out" != *"__EXIT=0__"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL isPrerelease:false case: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS isPrerelease:false case"
fi

# AC-015: missing isPrerelease key must hard-fail before any gh call.
out=$(run_case '{"releases":[{"tagName":"v1.0.0"}]}')
if [[ "$out" == *"gh release create"* ]] || [[ "$out" == *"__EXIT=0__"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL missing-key case: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS missing-key case"
fi

# AC-015: null isPrerelease must hard-fail before any gh call.
out=$(run_case '{"releases":[{"tagName":"v1.0.0","isPrerelease":null}]}')
if [[ "$out" == *"gh release create"* ]] || [[ "$out" == *"__EXIT=0__"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL null-value case: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS null-value case"
fi

# AC-015: non-boolean isPrerelease (a JSON string "true") must hard-fail before any gh call.
out=$(run_case '{"releases":[{"tagName":"v1.0.0","isPrerelease":"true"}]}')
if [[ "$out" == *"gh release create"* ]] || [[ "$out" == *"__EXIT=0__"* ]]; then
  echo "FAIL non-boolean-value case: $out"; fail=1
else
  echo "PASS non-boolean-value case"
fi

exit $fail
```
Then `chmod +x .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_github_release_prerelease_flag.sh`.

RUN (expect failure, against the CURRENT unedited action.yml): `bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_github_release_prerelease_flag.sh; echo "exit=$?"`. Expected output: `FAIL isPrerelease:true case: ...` (the old regex never matches `v1.2.3a1`, so no `--prerelease` is passed even though isPrerelease is true), `PASS isPrerelease:false case` (the old regex also doesn't match `v1.0.0`, so this one incidentally passes), `FAIL missing-key case: ...`, `FAIL null-value case: ...`, and `FAIL non-boolean-value case: ...` (the old loop never inspects isPrerelease at all, so it always calls `gh release create` regardless of that key's presence/type), ending in `exit=1`.

IMPLEMENT: In .github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml, find:
```yaml
              echo "::group::5. Creating GitHub Release Entries"
              for TAG in $(echo "$PLAN_JSON" | jq -r '.releases[]?.tagName // empty'); do
                if [[ -n "$TAG" ]]; then
                  echo "Creating GitHub Release for tag: $TAG"
                  
                  # Detect if tag is a SemVer prerelease (contains alpha/beta/rc/pre)
                  EXTRA_FLAGS=""
                  if [[ "$TAG" =~ -(alpha|beta|rc|pre|next) ]]; then
                    EXTRA_FLAGS="--prerelease"
                  fi

                  gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --generate-notes $EXTRA_FLAGS || true
                fi
              done
              echo "::endgroup::"
```
Replace with:
```yaml
              echo "::group::5. Creating GitHub Release Entries"
              while IFS= read -r ENTRY; do
                TAG=$(echo "$ENTRY" | jq -r '.tagName // empty')
                if [[ -z "$TAG" ]]; then
                  continue
                fi

                if ! echo "$ENTRY" | jq -e 'has("isPrerelease") and (.isPrerelease | type == "boolean")' > /dev/null; then
                  echo "::error::release entry for tag $TAG has a missing, null, or non-boolean isPrerelease value"
                  exit 1
                fi

                IS_PRERELEASE=$(echo "$ENTRY" | jq -r '.isPrerelease')

                echo "Creating GitHub Release for tag: $TAG"

                EXTRA_FLAGS=""
                if [[ "$IS_PRERELEASE" == "true" ]]; then
                  EXTRA_FLAGS="--prerelease"
                fi

                gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --generate-notes $EXTRA_FLAGS || true
              done < <(echo "$PLAN_JSON" | jq -c '.releases[]?')
              echo "::endgroup::"
```
This removes the `=~ -(alpha|beta|rc|pre|next)` regex entirely (AC-008), iterates entries via `jq -c '.releases[]?'` reading `tagName`/`isPrerelease` off the same entry object with no cross-entry lookup (AC-009), and hard-fails via `jq -e 'has(...) and (...|type=="boolean")'` (not the `//` operator) before any `gh release create` call for that entry when the key is absent, null, or non-boolean (AC-015).

GREEN: `bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_github_release_prerelease_flag.sh; echo "exit=$?"`. Expected output: `PASS isPrerelease:true case`, `PASS isPrerelease:false case`, `PASS missing-key case`, `PASS null-value case`, `PASS non-boolean-value case`, ending in `exit=0`.
COMMIT: `git add .github/actions/callisto-action/action.yml .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_github_release_prerelease_flag.sh`
tasks.commit_message:
fix(action): derive --prerelease from ReleaseEntry.isPrerelease, not a tag-string regex

The GitHub Release creation loop now iterates PublishPlan.releases[]
entries directly and reads isPrerelease off each one, hard-failing on
a missing/null/non-boolean value instead of silently treating it as
false. Removes the =~ -(alpha|beta|rc|pre|next) regex entirely, which
missed PEP 440 pre-releases like 1.2.3a1 with no matching substring.
